title: Compass Security details Pwn2Own Tokyo 2026 unauthenticated root code execution in Alpine iLX-F511 infotainment system
geo_basis: Pwn2Own Tokyo 2026 competition named in the sources
summary: Compass Security's blog says its team demonstrated unauthenticated remote code execution as root on the Alpine iLX-F511 in-vehicle infotainment system at Pwn2Own Tokyo 2026. The blog says the framework-service listens on all interfaces and passes received code to a Lua client. The ZDI advisory ZDI-26-824 (CVE-2026-118606) lists no patch and advises only restricting interaction with the product.
plain: Researchers showed that someone on the same network could run code as root on an Alpine iLX-F511 car infotainment unit. ZDI's advisory lists no patch.
exec: A flaw shown at Pwn2Own lets a network-adjacent attacker take over an Alpine infotainment unit; ZDI's advisory lists no fix.
action: ZDI's advisory advises restricting interaction with the product; it lists no vendor fix.

sources.name: ZDI: ZDI-26-824 Alpine iLX-F511 Framework Service Exposed Dangerous Function RCE
Compass Security blog: Pwn2Own Tokyo 2026 – Alpine iLX-F511

date_note: Dated by Compass Security's blog post of 25 November; the ZDI advisory was published 28 October.

validation.note: ZDI's own advisory and the discovering team's blog were read.
